read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

if action!='build':
 build=read(B/'compact-decode-query-build-r2/run-record.json')
 assert build['reason']=='completed' and build['exit_code']==0 and build['host_checks_pass']
if action not in ('build','safety'):
 safety=read(B/'compact-decode-query-safety-r2/run-record.json')
 assert safety['reason']=='completed' and safety['exit_code']==0 and safety['host_checks_pass']

 prior=read(B/'compact-decode-query-capture-r2/run-record.json');assert prior['reason']=='completed' and prior['exit_code']==0 and prior['host_checks_pass']

opts=['-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=10']

if action=='build':
 subprocess.run(['scp',*opts,str(B/'compact-decode-query-native-source-r2.json'),str(B/source['bundle']),str(B/source['script']),'baiying:D:/projects/'],check=True,timeout=60)
 ps="$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue';$t=$null;$e=$null;$null=[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('D:/projects/"+source['script']+"',[ref]$t,[ref]$e);if($e.Count){throw ($e|Out-String)}"
 parsed=subprocess.run(['ssh',*opts,'baiying','powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand '+base64.b64encode(ps.encode('utf-16le')).decode()],capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace',timeout=30)
 with (directory/'script-parse.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(returncode=parsed.returncode,stdout=parsed.stdout,stderr=parsed.stderr),f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 parsed.check_returncode()
command=['ssh',*opts,'baiying','powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:/projects/'+source['script']+' -Action '+action]
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace',timeout=source['transport_timeout_seconds'][action])
 dispatch=dict(command=command,returncode=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
 dispatch=dict(command=command,returncode=None,timeout=True,stdout=str(error.stdout),stderr=str(error.stderr),wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
 with (directory/'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dispatch,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 raise
with (directory/'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dispatch,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
remote=source['repo']+'/build/compact-decode-query-'+action+'-r2'
for name in ('run-record.json','product.stdout.jsonl','product.stderr.log','preflight.json','launch.json'):
 subprocess.run(['scp',*opts,'baiying:'+remote+'/'+name,str(directory/name)],check=True,timeout=30)
run=read(directory/'run-record.json');print({k:run[k] for k in ('reason','exit_code','wall_ms','host_checks_pass')},flush=True)
if result.returncode or run['exit_code']:print(result.stderr[-2000:]+(directory/'product.stderr.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-6500:],flush=True)
result.check_returncode();assert run['reason']=='completed' and run['exit_code']==0 and run['host_checks_pass']
if action in ('build','build-ck'):
 metadata='build-ck-provenance.json' if action=='build-ck' else 'build-provenance.json'
 for file in ([metadata,'qrt_ck_fmha_sm121.dll','ck-source-inputs.json'] if action=='build-ck' else [metadata]):
  subprocess.run(['scp',*opts,'baiying:'+source['repo']+'/build/compact-decode-query/'+file,str(directory/('build-provenance.json' if file==metadata else file))],check=True,timeout=45)
else:
 reports=[json.loads(line) for line in (directory/'product.stdout.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
 with (directory/'reports.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(reports,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 assert len(reports)==(27 if action=='safety' else 4)
 print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(reports),last=reports[-1]),indent=2),flush=True)
